steps.intent: Write an AI-generated reply tailored to the email (typed text in the recording is only an example) into the Message Body
Wait for the 'Draft saved' auto-save confirmation; never press Send
Return to the inbox via 'Back to Inbox' and repeat for the next unread email

dataFlow.field: sender name / email body (used to write the reply)

successCriteria: After typing the reply, a 'Draft saved' notice appears (div#toast)
The Drafts count (span#dcount) increases by one per processed email
The Message Body textbox contains non-empty reply text for each processed email
No Send action is triggered; emails are not sent
consequentialActions: Send email (Send button in the reply composer) — the widget must never press Send; the user only saved drafts

strategyHints.reason: Opening an email is a DOM click on the inbox row; no network calls observed
Email content is read from the rendered message view
Reply composer is opened by clicking the Reply link; no network evidence
Text is entered into a contenteditable Message Body; auto-save is triggered by input events
Draft save is confirmed only by the live 'Draft saved' toast and draft counter; no network ops recorded
Navigation back uses the 'Back to Inbox' button

openQuestions: Should the widget draft replies for all unread emails or only the currently open / newest N?
What tone or length should the AI-written replies use?
